modelErrorProviderSummaryUnavailable: The provider is temporarily unable to process this request
modelErrorNoResponseSummary: The model request was sent, but the provider did not respond
modelErrorNotSentSummary: The model request failed before it was sent
outputTruncatedNotice: The reply was cut off at the model's per-response output limit — a generation cap (max output tokens), not your account balance. Kun already tried to continue automatically. Use Continue to resume again, or raise the limit under Settings > Providers > model > Max output (tokens).
continueTruncatedTaskPrompt: Continue from where the previous reply was cut off. Keep each response shorter and split the remaining work into smaller steps.
runtimeFetchFailedAutoStart: Could not reach Kun. Auto-start is already enabled, so the local runtime may have crashed or is still restarting — retry, or restart Kun and check its logs.
